svg.title: Web2APK supported languages and frameworks
svg.desc: Three ways to build an APK: bundle a built site, load a live URL, or use plain HTML files.
svg.text: Works with almost any web stack
Pick the mode that fits your project. Only app.json changes.
Server code (PHP, Python, Node) does not run inside the APK. Host it online and use the url mode.
Not affiliated with the listed projects. Names are used only to show compatibility.
